summary: Build PMO, risk, compliance, dashboard, and remote leadership skills for complex donor-funded portfolios. Explore the applied course.
lede: Leading multi-country donor-funded portfolios and remote teams requires connected routines for governance, portfolio prioritization, delegated accountability, risk escalation, compliance, budget stewardship, and performance management. This course turns those requirements into practical work products, including portfolio charters, decision rights maps, RAID logs, donor compliance matrices, and executive dashboard concepts. You will practise assessing governance maturity, mapping dependencies, developing risk responses informed by ISO 31000, connecting results through theory of change and logical frameworks, and designing remote leadership workflows. The programme also introduces the PMI PMBOK Guide, MSP programme governance, OECD DAC evaluation criteria, and COSO ERM at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who coordinate donor-funded programme management across multiple projects, offices, partners, and reporting lines. It suits professionals who already carry delivery responsibility and need a practical leadership system for governing complex portfolios and distributed teams.
prerequisites: Prior experience managing projects, grants, programmes, partnerships, or country-office operations is recommended. You should bring a working familiarity with budgets, implementation plans, donor reporting, and team supervision. No coding or programming is required. Power BI, Microsoft Teams, or equivalent digital tools support the exercises, but the course uses templates so you can complete the work without advanced software skills.
